## Priorities for the Next Four Years
### Academic Excellence
Ensuring academic excellence and preparing our 8th graders for high school success.
### Student Behavioral Health
Supporting student behavioral health needs so every child can thrive.
### Fiscal Stability
Maintaining fiscal stability and accountability for our taxpayers.
### Early & Extended Learning
Expanding access to high-quality transitional kindergarten, preschool, and afterschool programs.
### Community Listening
Listening to students, families, and the community in every decision.
### State of the Art Facilities
Ensure high quality completion of new facilities projects and stellar maintenance at our 3 campuses.
## Sarah Duffy
I bring a personal and professional commitment to excellence. I am a parent of two children in the Brisbane School District and have lived in Brisbane for 15 years.
I am also a long-time government employee working in children and family services. I truly believe in the Brisbane School District vision of graduating students who are thoughtful, prepared, and engaged citizens.
## School Board Trustee Accomplishments
During my term on the Board, the Brisbane School District has seen many successes.
### Responsible Budget
Preserving a responsible budget that keeps the district on solid financial footing.
### Facilities Upgrades
Completion of state-of-the-art facilities upgrades that keep our children safe and prepare our schools for environmental hazards.
### Strong Fiscal Standing
Passage of ballot measures that ensure ongoing critical funding for libraries, arts, music, academic instruction, mental health, and social-emotional supports.
### Teachers & Staff
Retaining and recruiting phenomenal teachers and staff who make Brisbane schools exceptional.
## What People Are Saying
“
Having served as a Board member alongside Sarah Duffy for the past four years I have seen firsthand her exceptional leadership as Board President. Sarah is consistently prepared, thoughtful, and steadfast in prioritizing the best interests of students in every decision. I particularly value her meticulous attention to fiscal responsibility and commitment to ensuring equitable access to afterschool care and enrichment activities for all students. I wholeheartedly endorse Sarah Duffy for re-election to the Board.
“
I worked alongside Sarah for the last 4 of my 12 years as a trustee on the Brisbane School District Board representing Southern Hills. Together the Board worked very effectively to ensure Panorama, Brisbane Elementary and Lipman were thriving. I have full confidence in Sarah's ability to serve our community and support her campaign for re-election.
“
Sarah brings creativity and focus when addressing combined City and School District issues. She's a great collaborator and problem solver.
“
Sarah Duffy is a thoughtful parent who is passionate about our school district. Her proven track record as a school board member shows that she can help lead the district and navigate the educational needs of our children to be well-rounded members of our community.
“
I'm proud to endorse Sarah for re-election to the Brisbane School Board. Sarah is passionate about our students and is always striving to make the Brisbane School District better. She is committed to strengthening programs, expanding educational opportunities, and creating more recreational and extracurricular activities for our students, an area where our community could greatly benefit from more options. Sarah truly cares about giving our kids opportunities to learn, grow, connect, and thrive, and I'm happy to support her for another term.
“
I'm proud to support my good friend and fellow Brisbane mom, Sarah Duffy, for re-election to the Brisbane School Board! Sarah truly cares about our kids, our schools, and our community. She is thoughtful, dedicated, and always willing to listen and advocate for what's best for Brisbane families. Please join me in supporting Sarah Duffy for Brisbane School Board!
“
Sarah Duffy has been a strong voice for keeping our students' educational needs and safety at the forefront. She understands how quickly the demands of raising kids are evolving and the importance of staying forward-thinking. She has our full support.
“
Sarah Duffy is taking the academic development of Brisbane School District Learners seriously, bringing new ideas, systems, and oversight to the district. These changes would have benefited me as a student.
